case_brief.administering_body: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
case_brief.what_it_is: Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana is a government initiative aimed at providing affordable housing to eligible beneficiaries in urban and rural areas of India. It includes components like the Credit Linked Subsidy Scheme and Gramin housing assistance.
case_brief.entitlement: Eligible beneficiaries receive financial assistance or interest subsidy on home loans for the construction or purchase of a house.
conditions: Must meet the specific eligibility criteria defined for the Urban or Gramin components of the scheme.

draft: I am writing to formally report that I have not received the benefits entitled to me under the Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana. As a beneficiary, I have confirmed that I meet the specific eligibility criteria defined for the Urban or Gramin components of the scheme. Despite this, the financial assistance or interest subsidy has not been disbursed to me. I request the Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs to review my application and confirm the current status of my file. Please identify the specific record, documentation, or administrative condition that is currently blocking the release of my benefits. If there is any further information or correction required from my end, kindly provide clear instructions so that I may comply. I look forward to your prompt response regarding the status of my entitlement through the official grievance portal at https://pmay-urban.gov.in/. If this matter remains unresolved, I will escalate this grievance through the Centralized Public Grievance Redress and Monitoring System (CPGRAMS).

To,
Scheme grievance portal
Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs

Date: 09 October 2026

Subject: Grievance regarding non-receipt of Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana benefits

Dear Sir/Madam,

I am writing to formally report that I have not received the benefits entitled to me under the Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana. As a beneficiary, I have confirmed that I meet the specific eligibility criteria defined for the Urban or Gramin components of the scheme. Despite this, the financial assistance or interest subsidy has not been disbursed to me. I request the Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs to review my application and confirm the current status of my file. Please identify the specific record, documentation, or administrative condition that is currently blocking the release of my benefits. If there is any further information or correction required from my end, kindly provide clear instructions so that I may comply. I look forward to your prompt response regarding the status of my entitlement through the official grievance portal at https://pmay-urban.gov.in/. If this matter remains unresolved, I will escalate this grievance through the Centralized Public Grievance Redress and Monitoring System (CPGRAMS).

Yours faithfully,
[YOUR NAME]
[PHONE]
[EMAIL]
[ADDRESS]

final.markdown:
# Grievance regarding non-receipt of Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana benefits

**To:** Scheme grievance portal (no verified email - use the official complaint form)

You are writing to the Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs to report that you have not received your Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana benefits despite meeting the eligibility criteria. You are asking them to identify any specific records or conditions blocking your payment. If the issue is not resolved, you plan to escalate the matter to CPGRAMS.

```

Scheme grievance portal
Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs

Date: 09 October 2026

Subject: Grievance regarding non-receipt of Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana benefits

Dear Sir/Madam,

I am writing to formally report that I have not received the benefits entitled to me under the Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana. As a beneficiary, I have confirmed that I meet the specific eligibility criteria defined for the Urban or Gramin components of the scheme. Despite this, the financial assistance or interest subsidy has not been disbursed to me. I request the Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs to review my application and confirm the current status of my file. Please identify the specific record, documentation, or administrative condition that is currently blocking the release of my benefits. If there is any further information or correction required from my end, kindly provide clear instructions so that I may comply. I look forward to your prompt response regarding the status of my entitlement through the official grievance portal at https://pmay-urban.gov.in/. If this matter remains unresolved, I will escalate this grievance through the Centralized Public Grievance Redress and Monitoring System (CPGRAMS).

Yours faithfully,
[YOUR NAME]
[PHONE]

[ADDRESS]

Scheme and case sources:
- https://pmay-urban.gov.in/statewisepmayhouses/21/CLSS
- https://pmay-urban.gov.in/statewisepmayhouses/9/CLSS
- https://www.myscheme.gov.in/hi/schemes/pmay-g
```

## If there's no reply
1. **Scheme grievance portal** (https://pmay-urban.gov.in/ or support-myscheme@digitalindia.gov.in) — First. Use the administering department's official scheme or service grievance portal. https://pmay-urban.gov.in/
2. **Centralized Public Grievance Redress and Monitoring System (CPGRAMS)** (Department of Administrative Reforms and Public Grievances) — Escalate an unresolved grievance about a central government department or scheme. https://pgportal.gov.in

_Information, not legal advice._
